dedupe_keys.name: metro de panama s a mantenimiento en lineas 1 y 2 anos 2018 a 2025

description: Metro de Panamá S.A. - Mantenimiento en Líneas 1 y 2, años 2018 a 2025 is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Metro de Panamá. Información mensual sobre el porcentaje de efectividad en el mantenimiento de los ascensores, escaleras y torniquetes del Metro de Panamá en Línea 1 y Línea 2 para el año 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 y 2025. Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Metro de Panamá. Its tags are escaleras mecánicas, funcionamiento, mantenimiento elevadores, torniquetes. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2025-07-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
